About
Culmina

Version 1.0.0 · Made by Buffur

Reddit: u/Buffur
GitHub: Buffur

Data sources in the app

Target catalog: adapted from OpenNGC, by Mattia Verga, CC BY-SA 4.0.

OpenNGC on GitHub

Map tiles and place names: © OpenStreetMap contributors, via the OpenStreetMap tile servers and Nominatim.

openstreetmap.org/copyright

open-meteo.com

Light-pollution map: lightpollutionmap.app, opened in your browser; nothing is fetched by the app.

lightpollutionmap.app
In this preview

Night, Moon, weather and forecast values on these pages are sample fixtures stored with the preview, not live data. No weather, map or place-name service is contacted. Target search uses six example objects from the app's bundled catalogue. Example nights, plans and rigs are illustrative, not measurements.

Preview fonts are bundled locally under the SIL Open Font License.
